title.zh: Remotely exploitable PHP bug found on 70% of world’s websites
title.en: Remotely exploitable PHP bug found on 70% of world’s websites

current_state.zh: Two critical PHP flaws collectively dubbed PHP2Shell allow unauthenticated attackers to execute code on web servers, and while emergency patches shipped for PHP 8.2+, over a third of PHP-based sites remain unpatched and some 800,000 hosts run branches that will never receive a fix.
current_state.en: Two critical PHP flaws collectively dubbed PHP2Shell allow unauthenticated attackers to execute code on web servers, and while emergency patches shipped for PHP 8.2+, over a third of PHP-based sites remain unpatched and some 800,000 hosts run branches that will never receive a fix.
